pricing.title: Choose your path to
pricing.subtitle: Two complementary schemes designed for different needs. You can subscribe to both schemes simultaneously and enjoy all the benefits.

q1.question: Can I have plans from both schemes at the same time?
q1.answer: Absolutely! The Seed and Fruit schemes are complementary. You can be an early adopter with Seed while also adopting trees with Fruit.

q2.question: What are ChocoCoins?
q2.answer: ChocoCoins are our virtual currency that you can use to get discounts on physical products from the marketplace like chocolates, creams, and merchandising.

q3.question: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
q3.answer: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time from your dashboard. There are no long-term contracts or cancellation penalties.
